#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iostream>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
typedef unsigned long long ull;
const int MOD = 998244353;
const ll mask = (1LL << 31) - 1;

// Fast input
inline int ni() {
    int num = 0, b;
    bool minus = false;
    while ((b = getchar_unlocked()) != -1 && !((b >= '0' && b <= '9') || b == '-'));
    if (b == '-') { minus = true; b = getchar_unlocked(); }
    while (true) {
        if (b >= '0' && b <= '9') num = num * 10 + (b - '0');
        else return minus ? -num : num;
        b = getchar_unlocked();
    }
}

inline vector<int> na(int n) {
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = ni();
    return a;
}

// Modular arithmetic helpers
ll modh(ll a, ll M, int h, int mod) {
    ull a_low = (ull)a & mask;
    ull a_high = (ull)a >> 31;
    ull term1 = (M * a_low) >> 31;
    ull term2 = (M * a_high) >> (h - 31);
    ull q = term1 + term2;
    ll r = a - q * mod;
    if (r >= mod) r -= mod;
    return r;
}

ll pow_mod(ll a, ll n, ll mod) {
    ll ret = 1;
    int x = 63 - __builtin_clzll(n);
    for (; x >= 0; x--) {
        ret = ret * ret % mod;
        if ((n >> x) & 1) ret = ret * a % mod;
    }
    return ret;
}

ll invl(ll a, ll mod) {
    ll b = mod, p = 1, q = 0;
    while (b > 0) {
        ll c = a / b;
        ll d = a;
        a = b;
        b = d % b;
        d = p;
        p = q;
        q = d - c * q;
    }
    return p < 0 ? p + mod : p;
}

// NTT
vector<ll> nttmb(vector<ll> src, int n, bool inverse, int P, int g) {
    vector<ll> dst = src;
    dst.resize(n, 0);
    int h = __builtin_ctz(n);
    int highestOneBit = 1 << (31 - __builtin_clz(P));
    ll K = (ll)highestOneBit << 1;
    int H = __builtin_ctzll(K) * 2;
    ll M = K * K / P;
    vector<int> wws(1 << (h - 1));
    ll dw = inverse ? pow_mod(g, P - 1 - (P - 1) / n, P) : pow_mod(g, (P - 1) / n, P);
    ll w = (1LL << 32) % P;
    for (int k = 0; k < (1 << (h - 1)); k++) {
        wws[k] = (int)w;
        w = modh(w * dw, M, H, P);
    }
    ll J = invl(P, 1LL << 32);
    for (int i = 0; i < h; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < (1 << i); j++) {
            for (int k = 0, s = j << (h - i), t = s | (1 << (h - i - 1)); k < (1 << (h - i - 1)); k++, s++, t++) {
                ll u = (dst[s] - dst[t] + 2 * P) * wws[k];
                dst[s] += dst[t];
                if (dst[s] >= 2 * P) dst[s] -= 2 * P;
                // Compute Q = (u << 32) * J >>> 32 (Java semantics)
                unsigned __int128 prod = (unsigned __int128)(u) << 32;
                prod *= (ull)J;
                ull Q = (ull)(prod >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF;
                ull u_high = (ull)u >> 32;
                ull QP = Q * (ull)P;
                ull QP_high = QP >> 32;
                dst[t] = u_high - QP_high + P;
            }
        }
        if (i < h - 1) {
            for (int k = 0; k < (1 << (h - i - 2)); k++) wws[k] = wws[k * 2];
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (dst[i] >= P) dst[i] -= P;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int rev = __builtin_bitreverse32(i) >> (32 - h);
        if (i < rev) {
            swap(dst[i], dst[rev]);
        }
    }
    if (inverse) {
        ll in = invl(n, P);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) dst[i] = modh(dst[i] * in, M, H, P);
    }
    return dst;
}

vector<ll> convoluteSimply(vector<ll> a, vector<ll> b, int P, int g) {
    int maxlen = max((int)a.size(), (int)b.size());
    int hb = 1 << (31 - __builtin_clz(maxlen - 1));
    int m = max(2, hb << 2);
    vector<ll> fa = nttmb(a, m, false, P, g);
    vector<ll> fb = nttmb(b, m, false, P, g);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        fa[i] = fa[i] * fb[i] % P;
    }
    return nttmb(fa, m, true, P, g);
}

vector<ll> mulnaive(vector<ll> a, vector<ll> b) {
    vector<ll> c(a.size() + b.size() - 1, 0);
    ll big = 8LL * MOD * MOD;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < (int)b.size(); j++) {
            c[i + j] += a[i] * b[j];
            if (c[i + j] >= big) c[i + j] -= big;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)c.size(); i++) c[i] %= MOD;
    return c;
}

vector<ll> clean(vector<ll> a) {
    int len = (int)a.size();
    while (len > 0 && a[len - 1] == 0) len--;
    if (len == 0) return vector<ll>();
    if (len == (int)a.size()) return a;
    return vector<ll>(a.begin(), a.begin() + len);
}

void solve() {
    int n = ni();
    int K = ni();
    vector<int> d = na(K);
    vector<ll> f(20, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
            f[10 + d[i] - d[j]]++;
        }
    }
    n /= 2;
    vector<ll> g = {1LL};
    for (int D = 17; D >= 0; D--) {
        g = clean(convoluteSimply(g, g, MOD, 3));
        if ((n >> D) & 1) {
            g = clean(mulnaive(g, f));
        }
    }
    if (n * 10 < (int)g.size()) {
        cout << g[n * 10] << endl;
    } else {
        cout << 0 << endl;
    }
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
